description:
Join us on NYC’s top selling nightlife experience!! We consistently book out, so grab a ticket before it’s too late!

Celebrating our 1,000th guest!

The first round of drinks are included!

NYC is full of energy, and we're about to take you to a drag hot spot where queens command the stage with glamour, glitter, and killer dance moves. Get ready to join us for a care-free night featuring and drag!

Meet your group for the night while we sip the first round of drinks! Be prepared to “cheers” to our fabulous night ahead! While at the bar, we'll give you a quick history lesson about NYC drag and NYC LGBT nightlife.

After, we will walk to our drag show. You’ll have the opportunity to meet and take pictures with the queens. The night ends with a dance party!

Follow us on IG @TheDragCrawl.

** The drag show is standing-room only.**

We are also available to hold crawls any night of the week, so please send us a message if you don't see a date on the calendar.
hostdescription:
With over 300 5-star reviews, our guests are our priority! We will do everything to ensure you have a fabulous night out in NYC! We love meeting our guests from all over the world & look forward to showing you the shiny world of NYC nightlife!

YOUR HOST:

Justin: I work at an NYC startup during the day but at night I turn into a nightlife expert. I go out in NYC every week & I know the best bars & drag queens. I was inspired to host an inclusive night out for travelers & locals alike after taking my first Airbnb Experience in Mexico City in 2017.
locationDescription: This experience will give guests access to a night out with a local. All of our locations represent a taste of New York City's best nightlife scenes. The bars and specific drag shows are where locals go to soak up New York's most talented queens. Bringing guests on a drag show tour, allows them to access Manhattan's top nightlife in one night

reviews.text: So great, and so much fun. Im usually very shy at drag shows but this one was so energetic and Justin gets you a great viewing area, you can't not enjoy yourself
Absolutely loved it. Justin created a welcoming and warm atmosphere for people visiting the city. Learned some ins and outs for joining the drag community, and loved seeing the professionals at work!
Justin was a great guide and the night was so much fun. I recommend the experience to be safe if you want to check out the authentic drag queen culture of NYC
Really exciting experience with a passionate and super friendly host. Great with all the joy he brought us through the evening
This was my first Airbnb excursion and I love it! Justin was awesome! I was really debating on doing this event but I’m glad I did. Meet some peeps and had fun!

As my first Airbnb experience I had a blast. As a future Queer New Yorker this was a great way to network, meet like minded people and see the “gayborhood,” if you will! Justin was a wonderful host and you could tell how much passion he had for the LGBTQIA+ community and putting on this event.
Justin is an awesome host! Loved the whole experience! Felt like we were in a family atmosphere while also being at the NYC drag scene

Justin is a great host! The drag show was amazing! Highly recommend doing this if you have any interest in drag at all, especially if this would be your first drag show experience. Justin makes everyone feel comfortable, shares some stories and is a super nice guy.

Definitely a fun thing to do if you want to experience something different and are in for a party! Justin is a great host, super friendly and definitely someone I would become friends with. I had never been to a drag show before and had a lot of fun! It’s also a fun area with lots of nice bars and restaurants so I’d definitely recommend spending some time there.

So fun! Highly recommend for people who seen lots of drag or none at all! Justin is a great host with lots of knowledge of drag and gay culture in NYC. Definitely an experience you don’t want to miss out on!

If you're looking for a great night out in NYC, look no further! The Fabulous Drag Night Out was so much fun and a great way to meet other people visiting NYC. Justin was a great host with lots of info and recommendations!

This was my fist time at a drag show and it was amazing! The cast were gorgeous & talented. They put on a fantastic show. Justin was a great guide and very helpful during the entire night. He was very informative about the culture & history and would answer all questions. Definitely would join this tour again!
This is my first drag Queen show and I had so much fun. Definitely recommend if you have some free time and want to have go party, this is it!

This experience was a blast! Loved Ginger, she really added an extra something. My wife and I really enjoyed the show and stayed after to party it up a little at the bar. Recommend for anyone wanting a little latte of the Drag scene in NYC.
Amazing first experience at a drag show for me, and an unique chance to taste the local drag scene here in NYC. Feel really lucky to have stumbled upon this!

Thank you for showing us another side of New York. I've been to New York more than 10 times, but I've never done this before.
I'm going to recommend it to my friends as well
We saw one of the best drag shows I’ve ever seen! Ginger Von Snap was an exceptional hostess and we had such a fabulous time.

Justin is such a genuinely kind and authentically attentive host. Great knowledge of the area, the gay scene and the bars as well as being a master at navigating potential social awkwardness between people who don't know eachother, and may not even be fluent in each other's language, towards such a great and fun night.

His sincere admiration and love of the drag culture in NYC is infectious and I really really hope more people jump on this experience and support him building this AirBnB experience.

Amazing venue and incredible drag performances. Justin was a great host: very thoughtful, knowledgeable and charismatic. He was always checking up on us to see if we had any needs. He really hyped us up before the show, and the experience exceeded our expectations. 10/10.
#DragIsArt
Great experience!! I've already taken the experience twice and it's always amazing. You meet great people, and enjoy a drink while watching the best drag shows in the city!
Fantastic drag show! Justin is an excellent host. He was so friendly and made everyone feel welcome immediately. I had an excellent time and would definitely do it again.

This was my first Airbnb experience and it was super fun! The show was amazing and I loved getting to experience the NY drag scene. Justin was also a fun and friendly host, and we got to meet the gorg Ginger Snap!! You should definitely book this experience! :-)
This was some of the most fun I had on my trip. meeting new people was so exciting, and just the experience of the show itself was a highlight!
My first drag show and it was so much better than I expected! The queens, the wonderful host (Justin), and the bar itself were great. Highly recommend!
Justin was an amazing host and made my wife and my first drag show a very memorable one! Thank you for an awesome time!

I’m a huge fan of RuPaul’s Drag Race and this was my first-ever live drag show, so I was very excited! It was a great show, the queens are very talented and very funny. Also, Justin is such a fun human! His bubbly personality made this experience unforgettable.

Justin was friendly and welcoming. The drag show was amazing, the queens were spectacular. It was a very great experience to see drag show for the 1st time. However, it would be nicer if we could sit down while watching the show or the seats are guaranteed. As tourists, we walked all day long so it was a bit hard to fully enjoy the show while standing the whole time, let alone dancing, and worrying about people taking our front spots. I’m new and have never been to a drag show so these could be normal but it’s just my opinion. Other than that, it was a fun night!

Justin and Prianca were wonderful hosts! I was tragically late but they made me feel so welcome and relaxed, as if I didn't miss a thing. The venue was casual, the crowd was electrified, and the queens were on the ceiling! It was the greatest night I've had in a long time. I am so HONORED to be their 1000th guest. Here's to 1000 more!

We had a great time at the drag show evening. Meeting place was clear and Justin and the group made introductions before heading to the club for the performance. The queens and show were fabulous. It was an opportunity to see local talent that we would not have found on our own. Justin was amazing and made sure everyone was comfortable and knew what to expect. I would highly recommend and would go again next time I’m in NYC.

It was an experience where I could feel my passion.
However, it's not a place that you can only go through this experience, so people you know could just come in and enjoy it.

Highly recommend this experience!! We had so much fun! The show was amazing! Justin and Liz were great fun to hang out with and shared so much of the drag history in Hell's Kitchen. Everyone was very inviting!! Highly recommend this tour!!

Justin was amazing from start to finish. He not only brought in extra help so that I could invite ALL of my friends, he also gave us his full attention from beginning to end and created such a personal experience.

My husband and I were looking for an evening adventure for our first night in NYC and Justin's Fab Drag Night Out was the perfect adventure for us. Due to Covid, we met Justin at an outside bar along with other guests, enjoyed a drink, (ask Justin what the popular drink for Queens is!) and then had a short walk over to another bar for the show. The ladies were amazing, I wasn't expecting to see such talent. To be honest, I was a little upset to see the ladies look better than me, have bigger boobs than me and kick, do the splits and somersault better than me! But I got over my envy!

If this is your first show, bring $20 in ones...you will want to tip the ladies like those 'in the know' do.
Great experience! Justin and the team were awesome- wish there was more places we could have gone, but given Covid it was great.

If you’re considering booking this experience I would highly recommend that you do so before it sells out! Justin is an engaging host with good knowledge of the nyc drag scene and will take you to a quality spot. 10/10

I was 1 of 3 guests who participated in Justine's Fabulous Drag Night Out and I can safely say we all had a brilliant time. Justine was attentive and charming and helped to personalise the evening by introducing us to the two lovely drag queens who brought the house down with their jokes, singing ( yes one had a real voice) and dancing. Photos with the ladies at the end of the show capped a fun evening. I plan to repeat it the next time in NYC. Grant

100% Must Do!! Justin clearly knows his stuff, and took us to see some of the best drag performances I’ve ever seen. The place was packed, yet Justin got us a spot right up front and hooked us up all night long! It was an amazing experience and worth every single penny! Thanks for the best night!!
I actually booked this experience for my friend to celebrate her birthday. She loved it! Shared a lot of happy photos with me. Justin was amazing and I can tell they connected easily.

AMAZING EXPERIENCE! Justin was an amazing host and made sure we were all comfortable and got the best seats in the house! It was my mother’s birthday and she had a blast! 10/10 would do again ! :) Thank you Justin! Will 100% recommend this experience to anyone wanting to have fun and try something new! Love Love Loved it!
This was great! I went by myself and felt like if I knew everyone. Justin and Prianca are very positive, energetic, and chill at the same time. Totally recommend doing this!
Justin is a stellar host. NYC Queens are the fiercest fabulousness on the planet. And you’re bound to make new friends cause anybody who signs up for a drag bar hop is bound to be amazing.
This experience is a must!!! Justin was a wonderful host and shared a lot of knowledge about the neighborhood! If I could give more than 5 stars, I would!

What a great night to end our week in NYC! Justin was such a great host, from the initial welcoming messages to having a pre-printed list of drinks to choose from, he definitely made the night feel like one of a kind. I had never been to a show before, let alone went out in New York and without even asking Justin offered all the info needed for a night out on the town. From table conversations to The Queens, everyone was such a pleasure to interact with, no felt excluded. I will definitelybe recommending this experience to any and all my friends for a fun and entertaining night out 🙌🏽 Keep up the great energy Justin and congratulations again on your new job!!!
It was literally amazing. Best experience that I’ve had. Super recommend for anyone that wants to have a good time and see some gorgeous drag queens slay! ❤️
A really fun experience! Small group, amazing queens, and Justin is quite lovely. AND there’s a free drink included!! What a deal =}
We had so much fun on our Drag Night Out. Justin introduced us to all the Queens and we had front row seats for the performance. It was so fun and the highlight of our trip.

This is an epic experience. Justin is a great host who's warm and friendly. Also because Justin is such a big player in the drag community you get extra special attention from the queens and amazing seats for the show. Im very glad experiences like this are coming back after covid, I felt safe the whole time and even the drag queens themselves were wearing clear masks. I had a blast, highly recommend!

I had SUCH a great time with Justin! Took me out for a very personalized experience. I got to meet beautiful people and share my New York experience with someone who knows what they're doing. I would highly reccommend this as an experience you will never forget!

Amazing night, one of the best nights out, even during Covid times. Justin is an amazing host and extremely friendly. The show felt like a community and was incredible. In terms of Covid safety measures it was up to standard, show was outside, social distancing and wearing masks. Great night overall, would recommend to anyone wanting a night out in NY.

This was a super fun and a really great experience! My mom and I went together and we had a blast!!! The drag queen was amazing and she had us all dancing and cheering. Justin really cares about what he does and he is a wonderful host. Definitely book this!

Justin and Prianca were friendly. The whole experience was very fun! The tour group was full of people who were nice and wanted to have a good time And we were able to dance until 4am after the shows :). Even after the tour Justin gave us recommendations for the rest of our trip. SO GREAT :)
A great night to be sure! They make sure you get to the venue in enough time for a great spot up front. We saw 10min of one show and 1.5hrs at the second show.
A much-needed initiative, the drag crawl is a great step-ahead for anyone who wants to see the city with a more fresh perspective with respect to local context.

We love Justin and The Drag Crawl! He tailors the experience to the age of his group, so the pace will be perfect whether you're 21 or 51, or really any age. He's very insightful about the areas and shows we went to. It was great to find new places that I would've never gone to by myself. The Drag Crawl was my group's favorite night by far on our trip to NYC. We sincerely couldn't recommend this experience more!

Me and my sister had an amazing night with Justin. We enjoyed so much, it turned out to be the highlight of our trip in NYC!!! It was so nice to get to see a local drag show. Justin is simply a great host. Such a good vibe that made this experience better. He also told us a history of Hell’s Kitchen as well so that we could understand the background. Thank you for an unforgettable night. X

They were such great hosts and really cared that we were having a good time. It was truly an unforgettable night. And they took lots of photos!! Only issue is we all lost each other at the end of the night and wish we could’ve said goodbye.

Justin and Prianca made this experience so much fun! From the moment we met at the first bar they were friendly and just as excited about the night to come as we were. I would recommend this experience to anyone looking for a carefree, fun night of cheering, dancing and singing along with amazing company. The Hell’s Kitchen area was my favorite part of New York. The bar vibes and people were fantastic.
The experience was really awesome. Unique in a certain way! Every show was wonderful and hilarious! You get to know a little of the LGBTQ environment in NYC

Such a great experience !! My 2 friends and I booked this for our friend’s birthday trip in New York. Looooved it so much. Justin and Prianca were super welcoming and the Queens were amazing. Such a good time and definitely a highlight of my trip ! Hopefully they come to LA soon !!!

The experience was unique! I had no knowledge about Drags until I went there and Justin showed us the best places with the best shows. They were trying to make you feel comfortable at all times during the night and that was the best part of it. Cash it’s important for the experience, specially singles for the drags!

Looking to meet new people and have a taste of what NYC drag life offers? Drag Crawl provides the perfect taster for you to sample what NYC has to offer only for you to keep coming back for more! Absolutely the best way to meet the queens up close and get a front row seat as well as making new friends.
It was a fun night out in NYC. We all had a good time. The drag queens were fabulous. I was by myself but the hosts were very welcoming.
Great fun on the NYC Drag Crawl! Justin knows the ins and outs of NYC Drag and we got to meet some fantastic queens that know how to WEEEEERK!!!!!!!!

The Drag Crawl was very special and we loved every minute of it! Not only did we meet the Drag Queens but we also made new friends all along! If you’re up for a special night out in New York - do it with Justin!
SO MUCH FUN! Justin was so nice, welcoming with a great vibe and positive aura. We were so sad to leave him at the end of the night!
Justin was a tremendous host and he really cared about our experience. We had an amazing time and found some great new drag bars and and drag queens!
Justin was a great host! I had a lot of fun and it was a great start to our night out in NYC. Would 100% do again!

I suffer from social anxiety and panic attacks so I signed up for the experience to work on that and get out of my comfort zone. It was absolutely fantastic. Justin knows literally everyone including the performers. He knew where to be and when to be there so we didn’t miss a thing. He told us what we were doing and what to expect so there was zero ambiguity. He had great energy and quickly brought our little group of new friends together. He stayed engaged with the group and checked in with us individually throughout the evening. I never felt on my own. I got to feel like one of the cool kids for a night. Had a total front row VIP experience. I’ll probably do it again next time I’m in NYC.

Justin was so great and did a great job of making everyone in the group feel welcomed. The experience was amazing! I’ve been wanting to see a drag show in NYC for a while and Justin knew just where to go to see a great show.
Highly recommend this experience. I had a great time at the different shows and Justin did everything he could to make it a magical night.
For a first timer like me, it was an amazing experience. Justine was very accomodating and he let me felt that i belong

I loved this night! Made to feel welcome straight away and the free drink was a great ice breaker. I really wanted to see drag in NYC, but was travelling alone and was a bit unsure of where to go etc, so this experience made it super easy and the result was... incredible drag! It was great to meet other solo travellers and to continue partying the night away. Thank you!

This experience really is worth the reviews! From the moment of booking the tour Justin went out of his way to be helpful and amenable, nothing was to much trouble and that's before we even get onto the tour itself! Which was amazing! The show was fantastic and the bars afterwards were so much fun! It deserves every star! A fantastic host, great guide and just overall fun and lovely guy who's put together a great team and awesome night out. Would recommend to all!

I was on a solo trip to NYC and decided to go on the fabulous drag tour. So glad I did! I had a great time! You get so much more of a local experience when you let someone from the city show you where they go to have a good time. Justin and Prianca are the perfect hosts!

Drag show first-timer, here! If you are feeling a bit risqué, and as long as you have an open mind, you will get to experience NYC from a different perspective. Overall, my wife and I had a good time through the experience.

TIPS/ADVICE:
• MONEY. Performers work for cash tips. Bring your dollar bills, y'all!
• SEATING. There are no reserved seats for these shows. You might be as lucky to have snagged a seat, but you might also have to endure standing throughout a performance. Just in case, consider wearing something comfortable.
• DANCING/CLUB. During our experience, Justin took us to hear one of his favorite NYC DJs for a few minutes. You can either join the group on the dance floor or partake in a tasty beverage of your liking at the bar. Again, select an attire that will suit the mood.

If you're not a drag culture fan, this is a great start... If you are, then this is a pure celebration of drag culture! Justin is a lovely host, and he is ready to give you tons of local drags info, tips about the nightlife in NYC and great energy. No matter your style or personality, Justin will be able to make you feel comfortable and confident. This became a MUST DO in NYC for me.

Perfect night out for a bachelorette party!! Great vibe, great locations, great drag and great music. Last but not least, AMAZING host! justin was fabulous. Knowledgeable and personable. Really made sure everyone was comfortable and having a great time. So sweet. Would def recommend!!

The drag crawl was amazing! Our host Justin was super informative and personable and made us feel right at home. The shows we went to were exciting and unique and even got to see some of the queens from drag race! Would definitely recommend!

Justin is super passionate about drag, the NYC community, and making sure you have a great time. My sister and I had a blast! I would tell anyone to book this experience, especially if they've never been to a drag show. If you are looking for one hell if a night, book with Justin. PS- Dont forget your dollar bills, y'all!
Amazing time with a great group of people! My girlfriend and I had an awesome time seeing a show we wouldn’t have gone to alone. AMAZING show that was the highlight of our trip!!
Justin was very nice and accommodating. He was really looking after us. Treated us for a drink too. I highly recommend this experience.
Justin and Doug are soooo adorable!! They made sure no matter what they the group was counted for and we really enjoyed ourselves!! I recommend this bar crawl 100000 times ❤️

The Drag Queen Show was a blast and amazing!! Not only were the hosts Justin and Doug extremely accommodating but they were super friendly, gave us great background and insight to the drag queen performers and venue, answered my questions, and made our group feel very comfortable and welcoming. Justin and Doug were so much fun to be around, and I recommend this event to everyone, it was truly a wonderful time and it was nice to see the holiday show that the Queens performed, they were fabulous!!

It was fun！
I was always excited to be guided to bars as needed .if you leave it to NY night,you can be sure！
Great night at the 9th year anniversary of the drag show. We had a brilliant time and even got front row seats thanks to Justin and Doug! Would definitely recommend this night!!

Overall we had a great experience. The boys are lively and always making sure you have a great time. We had such a great time we were the last ones to leave at the last destination at 4am. Definitely would recommend as it was one of our favourite nights in NYC. Thank you

Justin, Thank you very much for all the night, it was really fun!
Hope to come back soon to NYC and make the experience again

This Experience was Awesomely Amazing! 😁Justin was an excellent host. We really felt cared for and included in this fun time together 😁 the shows were great and the drag queens were stunning and talented. It was so wonderful to make new friends and spend time together in NY. Thank you Justin for sharing this event with us 😁 I would highly recommend this experience ☺️❤️

What a fun experience! I’ve been to NY a few times, but with so many bars in the city, never know where to go. Justin took us on a great night out on the town to see some awesome drag and get some dancing in. He’s so personable, friendly, and genuinely wants you to have a great time. I highly recommend this crawl!

It was such a fun unique idea. Me and my friends had such a good time and the shows were top notch! I definitely recommend it! The only thing to be aware of is that you will stand the entire time and if you have been walking all day it's a little exhausting....but still worth it

An authentic experience, one of the best in New York, cause it was a lot of fun and real. We never would have done this on our own. But we felt very comfortable and Justin had taken care of our wellbeing from the beginning.
The experience was unforgettable and our host was warm and friendly. The entertainment and variety of entertainers was outstanding. We absolutely had a blast and would highly recommend this event.

This was our first time in NY and our first drag experience and it was amazing.

If you want a look into the drag and gay scene in NYC, this tour is for you!

New York City is such a magical place, and I knew I wanted to catch some drag shows. Sure, I could have done the research and go to the clubs on my own, but this was my first time in this city, and I wanted someone to guide me along. Justin truly made the whole experience more than just a night out with some strangers - he made us feel like we are friends. We walked to the bar and chatted along the way, and that by itself made the whole experience special for me. I never was a nightlife kind of person, and get quite intimidated by the whole idea of staying out late and going to a club or a bar, but Justin affable personality made the entire adventure less intimidating. Of course, the Drag Show that we saw was beyond superb (prepare lots of one dollar notes to tip these hard-working Queens!). I thoroughly enjoyed myself. It was unforgettable and probably one of the highlights of my virgin NYC trip.
The Drag crawl was great and Justin is more than accommodating! Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun and easy night out.

We had an amazing time on Justin's drag crawl. Both of the bars we went to were really fun and Justin and Scott did a great job of keeping on schedule and making sure everyone was ok. It was a really unique experience and gave us the opportunity to see a different side to the culture in NYC.

It was a really nice experience, we started with some drinks and background story, getting to know each other in the group a bit. Then we walked to the bars and saw some really nice drag queens! It felt like it went to fast tho =)

My friend and I are 60+, non-drinkers, and we both had a blast! Justin and co- host Zach were attentive and ensured we felt comfortable all evening. With good mobility we kept up with the beautiful group of young adults from all over the world. We both agree it was a highlight of our time in New York and recommend it highly... don't think twice, just join the fun!

Justin and his brother were great hosts.. very caring, fun, supportive and knowledgeable.. I had the time of my life 😊.. unfortunately we’re not able to see anything in the second club and the third club was a little chaotic but the drags there were very nice and very down to earth 😊..
thanks Justin for a fun and lovely time 😊
This experience was nothing short of amazing. Justin and his brother were terrific hosts and made everyone in the group feel included. 10/10 would definitely repeat 😂👍

I came to the city a girl on my own and wanted to party, and this was fun option. The host(s) were too cute both Justin and his brother. So nice, so welcoming. The meeting place was accessible, immediately I was immersed in a large group of hyped people visiting from all parts of the world. The complimentary drink was a great start to the night. The clubs we visited were super social and interactive. GREAT music. The dance club to die for. Zach* excuse my spelling, even helped me go back to a club to find my phone. I'd definitely do this again.

You think you can do this by yourself? Nope! Don’t think so. They know the good spots of drag Queens in Manhattan. Interesting how they go from very fine Queens to unpolished ones which I believe is brilliant! Giving you three different world of drag.

Had an amazing time with Justin... He was very insightful and knew a lot of detail about Drag shows and queens around. We were clearly explained with to expect and he did keep the drinks going. It did feel rushed, but well, thats the nature of the experience. Don't expect to stay back for a show, as we saw at one show!!

This experience was so fun. Justin is extremely kind, energetic and knowledgeable, I am from the city and he opened up a completely new area for me that I knew nothing about. All around great experience, 10/10 would recommend.

AH-mazing night with Justin and his brother as hosts! This Drag Crawl is beyond as fabulous as the description says because of Justin who clearly and genuinely loves being able to show his guests the Hells Kitchen Queen scene! Awesome shows, fantastic energy, loved it! Thank you and can't wait to go back :)

It was a great evening. We had so much fun! You get to see impressive Drag performances and can dance the night away. The communication is great and you feel welcome right away. Definitely to be recommended!

This is such a great experience that I’d recommend to any of my friends. I was able to visit a couple of Drag bars where the shows were so entertaining and energetic! Big thanks to Justin and his co-hosts for showing me a good time in NYC. Best thing to do as a solo traveller :)

This. Was. So. Much. FUN. I had a great night. Justin and his cohosts are lovely and clearly know the scene. We got one full drag show in at the end and I was in stitches, a few great quality comedy queens in the mix. Hangover rating the next day: 7/10 If you want a super fun night out, hit up Justin!

Justin was amazing, the experience was a once in a life time experience so well thought threw. Justin and dough was so caring and made sure we were safe and accounted for at all times. We had the best party ever and enjoyed the dancing and ladies on stage. What a night I would do this again and again. Thanks to Justin and his team

You are in for a magically fabulous night! Justin was absolutely wonderful - super communicative and very informed about the drag scene in NY. We went to 4 spots and each venue had its own vibe - this honestly exceeded my expectations!

Hope to do it again next time I’m in the city!!

Justin is a wonderful host, an expert in the story of the places we’ve been. He loves to share cool facts and makes other understand the drag culture better. We felt really confortable right from the beginning. I truly recommend to attend this experience. We loved it all along.

Such a great experience!! Been to New York several times but never got the opportunity to go to any drag shows... mostly bc I didn’t know where they are but Justin knew they best spots. Definitely would come again!! :)

Very good experience, totally recommended. Justin is very concerned that you have a good time and very well organized. Make an introduction to the neighborhood and places you'll be visiting. He's always worried you'll have a good time... The places we visited are very good with top-notch shows. Then, you can stay in the place to keep having a great time.
I loved the experience, Justin and Scott were always worried that we had a good time, and the drag shows they brought us were top notch. Thank you very much for an amazing experience
Brilliant! Justin made us feel part of New York. For a stranger in a new place that’s so important. What a great time we had

Justin was an amazing host - I had a blast on his tour of the NYC drag scene. As a local, I still felt the experience was unique and special. He was knowledgeable and attentive. Go with friends or go to meet friends, either way, well worth it.

Justin was a great host. He made everyone feel welcome and comfortable. We had a great time during the whole experience and Justin made sure he attended everyone’s needs. I definitely recommend this experience to anyone visiting New York, is it a great way to dive into the city’s nightlife 😉 I would definitely repeat next time I visit the city. Thank you Justin for a wonderful night out!

This was a really fabulous night out. Justin and Doug were super friendly and clearly love drag. Even though we were obviously a bit older than other guests we were made to feel really included. The drag queens were amazing and the bars were great fun. I highly recommend this experience. Thanks for s great night.
Super fun night out! The bars were wild and the queens were ablaze, henny. Justin is communicative and knowledgeable, I had a great time learning and laughing with him. Shantay you def stay! ❤️

We had so much fun on the drag crawl! Justin was so welcoming and we had such an amazing evening out! The shows were so cool, and Justin really made sure we were able to see them from the first row. You feel really special with him, he's just that amazing :-) Recommended for everyone who wants to experience a drag show in NYC, but doesn't want to go alone!

Most amazing night ever! The shows are breathtaking - really the best New York has to offer. Justin works really hard to include everyone and you can clearly see how much he loves it, which makes it all so much better. I went on a Friday and we watched two AMAZING shows and after the experience, Justin was kind enough to take us out to dance. Really makes you feel in New York City! I already want to do it again!!
It was a very fun event. Justin was enjoying himself and his good mood and energy were really contagious. I would definitely would recommend it and do it again :)
It was a great night. Justin let us to feel very comfortable. He was very accommodating. Nice group of people also. Thanks Justin! It was fun to go out with you.

Amazing drag crawl with passionate hosts that does that little extra to make you feel taken care of and important. So much fun, were much value for the money. I highly recommend this trip, you won’t regret it!

Fabulous experience. I love seeing local drag when I travel but I wouldn’t always go to the clubs on my own so this was a fantastic night. Justin and Doug were great hosts. So glad we got to catch the end of the drag race uk viewing party too. And the shows at Industry were fabulous. Would highly recommend this experience when in nyc.
This was a brilliant introduction to NYC nightlife. Travelling alone, I wouldn’t usually go out to a bar but this group was great and felt very inclusive.
It was a good experience, I met a lot of people and a bit of the rumba in new york, I would recommend it to others who want to attend a drag show...
Justin and his team were phenomenal. They genuinely cared if we had a good time and routinely checked up on us. They are masters of their craft and I’m thankful I booked when I did.

My bucket list included “See an NYC drag show,” but my past trips to Manhattan didn’t allow. However, this trip I was solo and jumped for JOY when I saw Justin’s Drag Show Crawl in the Airbnb experiences. I missed the meet up time as my Broadway show started 15 minutes late plus had a first act hold of 15 minutes due to technical problems. I texted Justin during the hold and he texted me right back saying to not worry and to text him when the show let out. I did and he immediately gave me the address of where the gang was. When I arrived Justin (and Doug!) found me and the fun ensued! The two bars on the crawl were across the street from each other so there was not even the teensiest lull in the partying! Justin and Doug were sooo adorable in keeping an eagle eye on our gang the entire evening. Justin pre-arranged front row seating for us at the 2nd bar so we were treated to fantastic, up close access to the fabulous “Wizard of Oz” spectacular show! Book this experience.
Justin's knowledge of the NYC drag scene really made this experience worth it! I would highly recommend to anyone wanting an especially unique night in NYC.

This night will remain one of my favorite memories in NYC!
It was a real show, with a caring and attentive host.
No matter your level of English, I highly recommend it.
Justin's tour was super fun, I hadn't seen the drag scene in NY, he told us about the LGBT scene in that area...and what can I say about the queens of NY ...AMAZING
Had a great night with Justin and co-host Doug, I felt safe and welcomed and got insight into the drag culture of NYC. Thanks for the wonderful night!

Justin (and Doug) are really into the scene and can help with questions. It was an awesome night out at the clubs of Hells Kitchen. We have been to different clubs with Drag Shows; although the time in the 1. one felt short the show and the good spots of the 2. show made up for that. Justin really cares for the whole group and loves to give recommendation for the entire New York Trip which was very kind.

This was a very exciting evening! My daughter and I have had lot's of fun. The shows, especially the second, were very amusing and special.
Justin and his co-guide Doug took care of all the guests from all over the world, and gave
us a good, secure feeling. Thx Justin and Doug!
Highly recommend this event.

Justin knows where to go for the best of the best of Hell's kitchen drag! And those queens know how to put on a SHOW! It was my very first drag show experience, and Justin made me feel very welcome and comfortable :) We had a wonderful time and danced with everyone for two hours after the show was over!

From the very start it was fun and I was very comfortable. We met people from all over the world join in our experience. We were all treated equally, with attention, direction, and kept in contact throughout the shows. So much excitement, laughing, talking, drinking and gorgeous shows, especially the finale at Queen, What a show it was and we were seated in the front of the stage. You must go !!! You won't regret it !! It was a ball !! Hopefully you will get to meet Justin, he was great to meet and he made it happen for us all.

Totally awesome fun night. The group was small and Justin was super friendly. We had a front row seat at Industry which was amazing. If you're looking for fun and something a little different, do this!

This was the highlight of my trip! Justin was so nice and welcoming and always making sure that we are enjoying it.
Highly recommend it!
Excellent experience. Justin and Doug knew exactly the places to go on a Wednesday night - the drag acts were excellent and had a really fun night of dancing and laughing! Highly recommend! 💝

A unique experience in the drag queen capital of the world! The community is vibrant and the shows are full of energy, laughs and a whole lot of love. Host Justin and Co-host Doug were super friendly and really cared about making our experience the best it could be. Would I return and do it again? It’s a big YAS from me!

This was hands down, the best night I had while in NYC. I work with Drag Queens for a living and have been to many shows all over the country. Justin and his team were super friendly, I loved meeting the people in our group and I felt like the experience was well organized. I would definitely recommend this experience and I am looking forward to doing it again next time I’m in NY.

One of the best air b n b experiences ever!
An immersion in a culture that was completely unknown to us but that we both loved!
A big thank you to Justin, a golden host!!!!

I am extremely happy I was able to do this last minute and fit it into my schedule. If you are traveling alone and still want to experience the night life and don’t want to go alone this is the way to go! The drag performance were spectacular and so fun to dance to! You’ll make friends from around the world and make incredible memories! I do not regret anything about that tight. It was definitely a night to remember and I wish I could relive it. Justin and his co-hosts were beyond AMAZING and so friendly. They made me feel safe and right at home and they exceeded the expectations I had of that night. I can’t wait to do this again when I’m in the city!

We had the most amazing night and so much fun!!! It was such a cool vibe, the group was awesome and the locations we went to were not crowded with tourists! We danced all night!
I can highly recommend this to anyone!!!

Awesome, awesome, awesome. Or actually I should say Fabulous!
Felt super welcomed and it was a fun night out! Hope you keep hosting more of these nights Justin, together with your partner in crime🤩 see ya soon!

This experience was awesome! Justin really cared about the group and was always trying to make everyone have their best time. He took us to great bars, with great drag shows and it was a night that I could never have if it wasn't for Justin and this experience. I highly recommend it!

The experience was amazing! Justin showed that he cared about the group and was always trying to make the most of people. He took us to great bars with great drag shows and I wouldn't have a great night out if it wasn't for Justin and that experience. I highly recommend it! He was cute and the experience is unique!

I'm glad I decided last minute to go on this tour, I seen drag shows a bit in my own city but because most are late and I sleep early I miss most or don't go out as much. Although since New York's time zone is ahead of mine I felt awake and excited the entire time! Justin is great and very friendly and felt like we were all already close friends from a while back, I would definitely book this experience again next time when I come by on day he's hosting this again. Even if I had gone alone to this I felt like I fit right in with the group so it was great and made my overall stay in New York that much more fun and memorable.

Justin is such a great host! This experience is highly recommended. I met a bunch of great people and especially at the last spot, the atmosphere was thrilling. Such a great night in NYC. Take me back!!

If you do one thing in NYC besides the obvious tourist things, do this! What a fabulous night out. Justin is so passionate about his city and goes out of his way to show the best of the best of the drag queen scene. Can’t recommend it enough. Thank you Justin xx
This was a great night. The final show was brilliant and we ended up staying until the bar closed. Justin was full of enthusiasm and it was fun being part of a larger group for this event.

Justin was born to host ! He was exceptional. He was excited, happy, welcoming attentive and genuinely fun! From the first moment you meet him, you know it will be a great night. We felt like VIP'S the entire night . We can not sing his praises high enough . Just a wonderful , happy and fun experience . We are thrilled !

This is a great experience! Especially if you’re not familiar with what to do, when the shows start and when they are over, etc. You can have as much fun as you want because Justin and Priyanka are there to keep watch and make sure everyone is having fun. It was a great night!
Justin is an AMAZING tour guide!!! Dina and I had an amazing time!!! Thank you for showing us this wonderful experience!!! Definitely will be referring you to my family and friends!!!!

Justin offers an amazing experience and highlights just how special NYC drag is, I’ve seen shows since I was a kid and these were easily the best. As a host Justin takes care of you and provides insights and connections that are hard to beat. Great night out, highly recommend and you will meet some wonderful people

My friend and I did this and we totally loved this experience!! Would highly recommend, we had the best fun, Justin and Priyanka were lovely and very friendly and tried really hard to make sure everyone had a good time. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone, we had a ball, stayed out dancing until 4am!

It was such a fun and unique (especially for those who live in Russia) experience!
I really enjoyed and recommend it to everyone!
Justin, thank you, was lovely to meet you!

If you’re thinking about booking this do it! Such a unique, wonderful experience! Justin and Prianca were so friendly, welcoming & warm. They had so much knowledge of the drag community and it was so interesting hearing about some of the history of the area. Highly recommend!!
A great experience that I would highly recommend to anyone traveling to New York for the first time and wants to experience Hell’s Kitchen firsthand!
My friend and I were looking for this exact type of experience in NYC and Justin's tour fit the bill. Thanks for the sweet experience!

Justin was such a great host. It was my first time in NYC, and this experience really brought me closer to the LGBTQ culture. His awareness and genuine care for his guests was outstanding. He facilitated friendship-making, which in general can be a difficult task with new people (and a group, nonetheless), but going to this drag show facilitated the dropping of barriers, which led to enjoyment.

Truly grateful I got to see such fantastic shows that highlighted the culture of drag. Would definitely go again!

I did this experience for my birthday and it was a great time! Justin and his co-host are really nice and helpful. They were thoughtful and fun.

The first show we went to was really crowded and we couldn't see, but other than that I had a great time.

Such a fantastic experience. Justins passion for the shows was fantastic and he really tried to connect with everyone to make sure everyone had a good time, which we all did! I had a great night, thanks! :)
Great fun, especially if you are travelling solo, good way to meet people. Justin was open and friendly and made the effort to talk to everyone. All in all good night!
Our host was Prianca. We had true VIP experience. We were walked in like we owned the place(s). Front row experience made it feel like we were part of the show.

Edit: Justin reached out and apologized. The next time I’m in new you’re I can’t wait to go out with him! The drag crawl was fun. Prianca was a nice host and friendly. I just wish we were able to find out more about the queens we saw and the variety of shows we went to. Based on the reviews I might have had a better experience with Justin as the lead host.

EDIT: Justin reached out to me below and in a private message and I’m changing my review to 3-stars. He was so sweet and apologetic and I have no doubt that this is his passion and the experience with him as host would’ve been 5-star.

Original: I think this experience would have been better with Justin based on the other reviews. It was Prianca’s 1st time by herself. She was sweet, but didn’t seem to have a passion for or thorough knowledge of the drag world. Her role during the experience was more so our timekeeper to make sure we left each bar on time. She did provide some history of Hell’s Kitchen when we met but that was about it. No beforehand info on the differences between each drag bar we went to or background on the queens we would see. Didn’t seem like enough of a regular to be leading a Drag Crawl tour. Again, she was very nice and sweet but the value of what we paid didn’t equate to the experience we had since each bar didn’t have a cover and we could’ve found them ourselves.

I definitely recommend this experience. Justin is very nice and professional. I definitely had fun! Also, I had to arrive later and he made everything possible to make sure that I was able to enjoy this experience with the rest of the group.
The drag queen show wzs great. We had the chance to meet other travellers and enjoyed spending time with them. Justin is a very friendly and nice person

I had an absolutely wonderful time on the Airbnb experience! Justin and Prianca were wonderful hosts, and really passionate about making sure that their guests are having a blast in Hell’s Kitchen. The finale drag show was AMAZING and I can’t recommend this experience enough. Sign up now!!

Justin was an enthusiastic and caring host. He worked hard to make sure that everyone was having a good time, and it was clear that he loves hosting these experiences. It was definitely difficult to keep everyone coordinated and moving from bar to bar on time, but he managed it expertly. We went to some really fun places, and it was great interacting with Justin and the other guests; everyone was there to have a good time. Thanks!
We had a blast going out with Justin! I’ve never done an air bnb experience before so I didn’t know what to expect. But this was a fabulous fun night

This was probably the highlight of my trip! Justin is an amazing host! He and Prianca greeted us like old friends and I felt welcomed right away. Justin has great knowledge and a lot of good recommendations for gay night life in NYC. I was a bit worried that since I was traveling solo, more people would come accompanied and I would feel left out, but it wasn’t the case at all, everyone was super friendly and we were all very excited for the show. Only downside was that we didn’t get to a bar due to a gas leak but that was totally out of Justin’s hands and we still made it on time to the main show. I completely recommend this for any drag fan, the talent the girls have in New York is incredible! Even if you don’t get to see big names or Drag Race alumni, you’ll still have a really fun night! I’ll definitely try to book it again when I come back to the city!!

Justin is just the best host ever. He was sweet, patient, fun and welcoming. I booked this for my first night in NYC. It was amazing. We were lucky enough to have a really cool group of people. The drag show was simply amazing it should have been on Broadway. Trust me if you book this experienced it will be the highlight of your trip it certainly was for me.

Justin was an amazing host. I was running slightly late, but he made me feel right at home and answered my worried messages quickly. The shows and the group of people we had were wonderful. Highly recommended!

Had such a good time during this experience!! NYC is known for having some of the best drag queens in the world, but as someone from out of town (and traveling solo), I had no clue where to start to see them. This tour allowed me to experience that and more!
For fans of drag (including RPDR), and those curious to check it out, this tour’s fantastic.
Justin is a wonderful host who truly cares about his guests. Our group composed of mostly solo travelers from all over the world, but very quickly felt as if we’d all known each other for years. Don’t hesitate if you’re traveling solo— I had hesitations at first, but now wouldn’t trade doing this for anything.
No matter your orientation or travel status, this experience is super welcoming and fun, and I absolutely would recommend and attend again given the chance.
Was not sure if booking this tour was going to be as fun as I thought. If you like meeting new people this is a great one for you!!!! It exceeded all my expectations 😃
The experience was FABULOUS. Justin was beyond great. He very much made everyone feel welcome and from the start had the entire group (of 13 strangers) feeling like old friends!

Justin and Priyanka removed all the reasons why people don’t go out at night in a town they’re visiting and made it feel like we were going out with a bunch of friends. No one was left out. It was very fun

Justin was great, the show was exceptional, much better than we can see in Europe. Just an advice : don't go alone, it is much better if you can share the experience with someone in the same mood as you :)
Justin was a gem. This experience was a highlight of my trip, quite possibly the whole year. When I return to New York I’ll plan a repeat, if this experience is still available.

It was so much fun.. I gave so much tips on the last show I lost count and it was all worth it. All the drag ladies were impressive and hilarious even. Justin and Priyanka really make sure all of us were having fun and gets a good spot for the shows. Don't even think about it, just make time for it and you'll have fun!

Unforgettable tour ! I strongly recommend this tour to Everyone. This is New York and also capital of LGBTQ / DRAG QUEEN. You must come and see how wonderful this show is. And this tour is going to be very rare opportunity for Asian or some very closed/limited city/country. I must say that this is really rare opportunity. Please get a chance to see !

On my first solo trip ever, I was on the hunt for things to do that would help me interact with friendly, fun and open minded people. Justin's tour is exactly that. Everyone is there to have a great time and he was able to turn us from a shy quiet group into friends in a very short time.

Justin and Prianca were excellent hosts, ensuring that no one was left behind and everyone was enjoying their self, they were personable and knowledgable. It was the small touches from  the welcoming hugs to arranging us so we had excellent seats and checking in on everyone that made all the difference.

The shows were a riot, unfortunately I don't remember the MCs name from the last show but they were by far my favorite and an absolute pleasure to watch. I only wish I'd brought more dollar bills!

Thank you Justin for creating and sharing a comfortable and inclusive environment in a city that can feel a bit intimating. This is not an experience to be missed and I only wish I lived closer so I could go more often.

I came with expectations on New York’s drag scene. I’m a die hard drag fan, and a performer myself. Justin was great, and also very knowledgeable of the drag scene. Justin makes it easy to just relax and enjoy the show. I would recommend this for anyone who wants a good time. It’s a great night out! This definitely exceeded my expectations!

This is a must-do experience! Whether you have never even seen a drag queen in person, or you’re the biggest Drag Race stan on the planet, you will love every second of your night!

We had such a mix of people: locals, first-time visitors to NYC from around the country/the world, and ages ranging from fresh college grads to grandparents! We all felt like old friends before we even left DBL for our first taste of Thursday night Hell’s Kitchen drag life.

Justin is the *best* host. He welcomes everyone from the start and makes sure all are comfortable and enjoying themselves the whole night. On top of that, he is so knowledgeable and will maximize your experience at each location and make you feel like a regular from the second you walk in.

Whether you come alone or with a friend (or 4), I guarantee you will have the best night on The Fabulous Drag Show Crawl!!

Everything was well organized. First, we had a drink and then we visited 2 different bars and saw 2 shows. Justin took really good care of us, shared personal stories and even got us seats in the first row of the main show. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED :)

If anyone is looking to have a great night in NYC, this is it. Justin’s sweet and amiable disposition allowed everyone to get comfortable and be themelves amongst strangers. Coupled with an extensive knowledge about the community, Justin not only made the trip fun, but also insightful.. This is my first night and first time in the Big Apple and Justin has already set a high expectation.

Thank you for creating such event Justin!

Justin is awesome! He was very enthusiastic and showed us a great time. The drag shows were great! Justin's "history lesson" of Hell's Kitchen and the drag scene added to the experience. He was attentive to the group the entire evening.

This was a fun experience! Justin was very knowledgeable about the location and drag. The group we were with was also very fun. My only issues was this was something we could of done on our own (minus the history) there was not anything additional that made it special
This was an amazing experience and everything ended up being better than expected! Justin really goes above and beyond for his guests to make sure that every single person has great time!

Awesome night, great places! The crawl was really fun and the price is excellent. If you feel like dancing, partying, meeting amazing people from all over the world and enjoy the exclusive energetic night clubs of the Big Apple! ....and on top of that, having an Amazing host like Justin.... Get ready to pay for soreness the next day! Lol! Definitely our best night out in NYC!
Excellent experience, very unique and fun, Justin is a great host and super nice person. I would recommend this to anyone who likes to have a nice time and would book it again.

Absolutely amazing night out! Justin is a great host. As a solo traveler I felt very welcome and the atmosphere in the group was superb, everyone just partied together and the drag shows were top quality. I made so many friends jealous that I saw Phi Phi O’Hara perform! 10/10 would book again.
Justin is such an amazing host! He embodies the spirit of NYC and makes sure you feel right at home, even if you’re visiting from far away. We had so much fun and hope to come back very soon!

As a lone traveller, I was a bit anxious coming into this, but Justin definitely made me feel welcome the moment I stepped into the bar. I recommend this to RPDR fans/solo travellers/first-timers in NYC who want to experience NYC's drag scene with experienced hosts! You'll not only enjoy the shows, but also get to meet cool people in your group because anyone who books this experience is automatically cool in my book! :)

Wow, what a night! Thanks so much Justin for showing us NYC’s fabulous drag scene. This was a truly remarkable experience and I felt like I saw some of the best performers the city has to offer. Justin was great at fostering a friendly group dynamic so it was ideal for solo travellers or for people wanting to experience something more authentic. I’ll recommend it to my friends!
Justin's Airbnb Drag Show experience was perfect, I never knew and dared to go by myself. Justin is very attentive to each guest. I highly recommend this experience!
Justin was awesome! He created a great group dynamic and was able to move us from bar to bar efficiently. I really enjoyed the experience.

This was my first event on my first trip to NYC and it's something that I would definitely do again if I get the opportunity. The experience would be unique each week, but just as amazing as my first time in NYC. You'll have a blast!

Justin was the best host! You can tell he’s really excited to show the group around and taking us to the hottest spots.

Not only did he take us to a few spots, he gave us a quick the history about Hell’s Kitchen.

All the shows were amazing and so much fun! 10/10 would recommend it!
It was a great experience and definitely worth it! As a solo traveller I wouldn't have had the confidence to go on my own so having Justin and the group was great. Would definitely recommend it.

The night was amazing! We came in from out of town with some knowledge of NYC drag, and by the end of the night Justin made sure that we knew exactly what NYC drag was about. Justin shared some facts about the area we were in, which was really interesting and a fun little history lesson. The bars were busy that night, but Justin did his best to make sure we had a great view for the amazing performances! Justin made us feel very comfortable as soon as we met everyone else in our group, and encouraged everyone to have fun and make it a great night. If I could, I would go back and watch the shows I saw that night because the talent in NYC is seriously one of a kind. I would highly recommend this to someone who wants to go out and have a great time. Thanks Justin!

Justin was communicative right at the onset. He displayed enthusiasm and set the right tone for a fun night.
He shared interesting trivia about Hell’s kitchen in turn keeping the group engaged.
The drag shows he took us to were definitely enjoyable.
All in all it was a fun night!

This is an amazing experience for drag show fans! Justin was really sweet, informative and cared about the group. He created a nice group dynamic and we got to know each other. He knew a lot about the area, the history of the bars and everything LGBT related. I recommend this experience. I had a lot of fun and the shows were AMAZING! You won’t regret it.

Such a fantastic experience. NYC has some amazingly talented queens and Justin showed us the best of them. He is a fantastic host and the group bonded really well - I’ve definitely made some lifelong friends.
It's been a unique night and amazing! Highly recommend! Justin was wonderful and attentive all the time! And the shows were breathtaking!
Had a great night!. Met some lovely people and Justin was an amazing host. If you're looking for an amazing drag night in NYC and need a little guidance, this is for you!

Such a fun night! Justin radiates a passion for showing you an unforgettable experience and gives off the most exciting energy that takes over the entire group from the moment you all meet through the end of the night. Thanks to Justin, you really feel like you just made a group of new friends from all over the world. He takes care of everyone in the group and makes you feel like an insider into the Hell’s Kitchen scene. We got to watch two incredible drag shows and Justin made sure we had great spots to see all the entertainment. If you’re looking for the quintessential gay-NYC night out with an incredibly kind, entertaining and knowledgeable host, you have to book this experience!!

Justin is an incredible host and you can feel his energy right when you step into the first bar. He makes each guest feel comfortable and ensures they have THE BEST experience (i.e getting them front row seating of the queens/good views). His passion and kindness are truly contagious and his event was the highlight of my week. I highly recommend this experience if you want a fun, exciting, unique night on the town and become better educated about Drag Culture. I am recommending this experience to all of my friends!

Justin is fantastic and the shows were wonderful. I highly recommend this experience! Great way to see a part of the city that is overlooked and under appreciated. Not to mention it is just amazing fun. GO! You won't regret it.

I would highly recommend Justin's Drag Show Crawl. I booked this for me and my fiancée for her birthday as she is a big fan of Ru Paul's Drag Race and she absolutely loved it. It was great fun. Although we live in the city, Justin showed us a whole new side to it which would be hard to experience without local knowledge. His passion and warm character made it a very enjoyable experience for all who attended.

Justin met us at a bar in Hell's Kitchen, bought us a drink and talked us through how the tour was going to unfold, what we should expect and worked well to gel the group socially. From there, we walked to our next bar where we saw our first drag show. The bar was teeming with people and there was a great atmosphere. We then moved on to a second place nearby where there were 4/5 drag queens who had various acts MC'ed by a very hilarious host. Apparently a lot of the acts had links to Ru Paul's Drag Race so you felt you were getting the crème de la crème of the drag world.

Without doubt, this is a highly recommended good-value NYC experience that caters to everyone; whether you are a drag expert / Ru Paul mega-fan or if you who have no prior knowledge or experience whatsoever and are looking for a fun night out a little off the beaten track. Enjoy.

This was my first drag show and I was so amazed by the quality and the fun vibe. Justin is a great host. He would be such a fun friend, and on this tour he makes you feel like you've been friends for years! He communicated super clearly throughout the night so I could relax and enjoy the experience without worrying I'd get lost in the crowds or not know what was going on.

Great if you’ve never been to NYC and don’t know where to go to meet/be around like-minded people. The bars were cute but I’d recommend pregaming, New York being New York and all. We ended up meeting another great couple in the group who we spent time with during the rest of our trip. Definitely would not have happened without this event. Thanks, Justin! We had a great time!

Where do I start? I am from Houston and I was in New York in February for NYFW . Justin was very accommodating and could not wait to show us Texans a great time. He was very hospitable and so much fun! The girls put on a great show. I felt at home. We even made friends with the other couple in my group. We had so much fun!!!! Thanks Justin! I will refer my friends to this experience when they visit New York.

This was such a blast! Justin was an amazing, friendly host. He made me and the other 3 guests in the group feel very welcome, and really knew his way around Hell's Kitchen. I felt like I owned the streets of NYC strutting from bar to bar. Justin even knew locals in every bar we went into and that just made the experience all the more fun! The drag shows were the best I’ve seen and I loved dancing afterwards with Justin and the rest of the group! If you are trying to have a fun night out and want to experience LGBT nightlife in NYC then this is a must!!
The drag show was amazing! I had a lot of fun and a great evening! Justin is awesome and shows great enthusiasm. It was a great experience and I would do it again! Thank you Justin :)

I never visited a Drag Show before. So a friend and I decided to give it a try in NYC. It was one of the best events we saw that week. We started with „get to know each other“- drinks, then stopped at two different shows. I was amazed!! The Queens were spectaculous. The wigs, makeup and costumes were pretty much to die for. All in all we had a great night. Thanks Justin!
It was awsome! The group dynamic was truly fun, I definitely recommend this experience to anyone new in town and who wanna have a real good drag night!

An absolutely fantastic experience. Perfect for a late night activity after a broadway show. Justin was a great host. He made sure we were all having fun and made sure we got great seats and showed us the ropes for those of us who had never been to a drag club before. Highly recommended.
Everything was great. I met the best host and other guests. Justin knows the best bar in Hell’s kitchen. I had such a nice time!

I recommend this to everybody. I saw 3 shows and all of them are wonderful! I also met great people!
Стоит поместить обязательно! Организатор очень дружелюбный и гостеприимный! Уделяет очень много внимания! Шоу было великолепным! Мы ходили в четверг, посетили 3 заведения, но все было очень органично организовано. Организатор реально париться чтоб всем было комфортно и удобно! Всем советую, в памяти точно останется на долго!
I 100% recommend this experience to anyone wanting to have a fun night out on the town! Justin was amazing, can’t wait to have my freinds take this bar crawl!
We had a great time - some of the best drag shows I’ve ever seen! The group was great too! Justin is a really good host and he’s good at making everyone excited.

Justin's experience was very enjoyable and just what visitors to the city need! I went on a Saturday night and he knew which bars would be the best to hit up for a night of fun and dancing.
